title: Aramid and zirconia coated separator for enhanced electrochemical performance of lithium-ion batteries
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35436-35444
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03903G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Daofa Ying, Kuo Chen, Jiazheng Lu, Chuanpina Wu, Baohui Chen, Yang Lv, Yutao Liu, Zhen Fang
A biomass-derived aramid-ZrO2 composite separator for Li-ion batteries has superior electrolyte wettability, thermal stability and ionic conductivity, enabling 128.2 mAh g−1 discharge capacity (10C) and 93.5% energy retention after 1200 cycles.
